Run the Bayesian adaptive design on one simulated trial

Source: R/designs.R
run_bayes_adaptive.Rd

Run the Bayesian adaptive design on one simulated trial

Usage

run_bayes_adaptive(
  trial,
  looks = c(124, 185, 247),
  c_eff,
  f_fut = 0.2,
  futility = TRUE,
  a0,
  b0
)

Arguments

trial

Output of simulate_trial().

looks

Increasing event numbers of the analyses (last = final analysis).

c_eff

Efficacy threshold: stop and reject if P(HR < 1 | data) > c_eff.

f_fut

Futility threshold at interim analyses: stop if P(HR < 1 | data) < f_fut.

futility

Apply the futility rule? (FALSE for non-binding calibration.)

a0, b0

Shape and rate of the Gamma prior (same prior in both arms).

Value

Named numeric vector: reject (0/1), stop_look (index of the analysis at which the trial stopped), stop_futility (0/1), hr (Cox HR at the stopping analysis), n_events, t_cut, n_recruited.
